title: Family Relationships
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner outlines family roles (parents provide, guide, protect; children obey, help, respect), identifies healthy practices (talking, forgiving, praying and eating together), outlines causes of family conflict (money, alcohol, poor communication, unfaithfulness, favouritism), proposes solutions (dialogue, forgiveness, counselling, prayer), describes how children relate to parents (Ephesians 6:1-3) and lists five values for harmony (love, respect, honesty, forgiveness, patience).

floor.question: Name a value that keeps a family stable.

steps: List causes of conflict and propose solutions.
contexts: a quarrel over money at home

board.do: Draw two columns: cause of conflict and solution.
Wait for the learner to propose one.
List five values for harmony on a hand.

misconceptions.ask: What do parents do for children?
misconceptions.repair: List what parents do: provide, protect, guide, teach, love, discipline (Ephesians 6:4; Proverbs 22:6).

misconceptions.ask: Which is a healthy family practice?
misconceptions.repair: Contrast healthy practices (talking, forgiving, praying, eating together) with harmful ones (shouting, silence, violence).

misconceptions.ask: What does Ephesians 6:1 say children should do?
misconceptions.repair: Read Ephesians 6:1-3 and Colossians 3:20; discuss obeying "in the Lord", in what is right.

listen_for: Stop talking to each other until it goes away
misconceptions.ask: Which is a good solution to a conflict in the family?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 18:15 and Ephesians 4:26, 32: go and talk, do not let anger last, forgive.

checks.question: What does Ephesians 6:1 say children should do?
Propose a solution to family conflict.
